cohort: 2052 children in Peru (mean age at baseline 1 year, 50% girls)
finding: Maternal BMI, low physical activity, cesarean birth, almost daily snack consumption, and almost daily consumption of sweetened beverages increased the risk of developing obesity in children and adolescents in Peru.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth increased the risk of developing obesity (IRR 1.63; PAF 11.4%).
